QuestInfo.name: Blue Dragon Cannon
QuestInfo.0: Get details about the Blue Dragon Cannon development from #bCartalion#k.
QuestInfo.1: #bBeldar#k will tell you what you can help with.
QuestInfo.2: You agreed to help Beldar with the Cannon development.

0.0: Let me get you up to speed. We've been rebuilding the Blue Dragon Cannon in secret for months.\r\n
0.1: I'm sure you know how big a responsibility this sort of power is. The ancient Nova did not take it lightly, and nor shall we.\r\n
0.2: This is our key moment to take Heliseum back from Magnus.\r\n
0.3: I don't really like that we're turning to this sort of raw destructive power, but the council seems to think it's the only option.\r\n
0.4: We're nearly finished, but we need some parts.\r\n
0.5: First and foremost, you need to gather those parts for us. Will you help?\r\n

yes.0: #bBeldar#k can tell you what we need. Good luck.\r\n

no.0: Didn't Piston send you here? Come back as soon as you can then.\r\n

1.0: Ah, the famous Paragon of Peace! I heard you've gone to some trouble to help us out.\r\n

yes.0: So, you're helping out with the Blue Dragon Cannon. Give me a moment to finish up here, and I'll get you up to speed.\r\n

default.0: Beldar can tell you what we need. Good luck.\r\n
